steps.title: Tell us your plans
steps.text: Send photos, plans or a description. We ask the right questions.

steps.title: Site visit & quote
steps.text: We inspect the site and send a clear written quote.

steps.title: We build
steps.text: Work starts on the agreed date, with regular updates.

steps.title: Handover
steps.text: We walk you through the finished work and fix anything outstanding.
